title: platform-objects: sys_organization declares no invite action, so an organisation record page cannot offer 邀请成员 in its header (page:header ids resolve only against the object's own actions)
body:
Ruled: 6228318638 · letter B′ on #24034 (batch #358 item 3) · 2026-10-17T02:10Z
Scope by the ruling: the declared invite action as the Done-when below says (`record_header`, `variant: 'primary'`, first by `order`), plus `leave_organization.confirmText` naming what is lost (the organisation's environments and members) in both bundles — #24021's copy half, carried here; no spec key. `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` + `pm:retriage` in this act.

Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 (the organisation page: 邀请成员 primary, 退出组织 out of the primary slot and disabled for the last owner) cannot be done in cloud with what the spec declares. The os-dev on that card measured each gap with contract probes at framework `f7e836da` / objectui `ef71a09f` (report on cloud#2910). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectstack issue names an invite action on `sys_organization`.

## The gap
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts` L61–188 (at `f7e836da`, unchanged on `main` `022c6e79`) declares no invite action. `invite_user` is declared on `sys_member` and `sys_invitation` only.
- A `page:header`'s `actions` are ids that resolve only against the page object's own actions: spec `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` L711, and objectui `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` L263.
- A host cannot add one:
  - `ObjectExtensionSchema` refuses `actions` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L3827);
  - a top-level `objectName` binding merges only into objects declared in the same stack (`stack.zod.ts` L4127, L4268);
  - an inline action object is refused in `page:header.actions` (`invalid_type`).

## Done when
`sys_organization` declares a `record_header` invite action:
- better-auth `organization/invite-member`, with `recordIdParam` `organizationId`;
- email and role params as `sys_member.invite_user` declares them;
- variant primary;
- the same membership gate.

This route is preferred to teaching `page:header` to resolve another object's action ids, which would reopen the ids-on-own-object ruling (#11592).
